items.docs: Generation fuel mix (in megawatts) of units cleared in the day-ahead market for the various fuel types in the MISO footprint, by region in hourly intervals. Available at 2pm EST the day before. 'Coal' includes combination coal/gas units; 'Gas' includes combination oil/gas units; 'Storage' includes pumped storage, ESR, and battery units. 'Solar' data is only available from 2022-01-01 onwards.
